title: Net Walk
summary: A cable puzzle: turn the tiles until every computer is on the network.
description: Turn the tiles until the server's power reaches every computer. A tap turns a tile clockwise, a long press the other way, a hold locks it. Four sizes: 5x5, 7x7, 9x9 and a 9x9 board whose edges wrap. Best moves and times are kept per size. Touch or keyboard; drawn in a Palm OS colour look that scales crisply to the screen. No network. Needs a screen of at least 480x320 (portrait 480x640 in PDA mode).
